issues.detail: The Greek 'αν δυναιμην' (if I were able) is rendered as a rhetorical question 'Làm sao tôi có thể hiểu được' (How could I understand), which changes the grammatical structure from a conditional statement to an interrogative one.
The Vietnamese translation omits the specific condition 'εαν μη τις οδηγηση' (unless someone leads/guides [me]) as a direct condition for his ability, turning it into a separate question.

The Greek 'αναβαντα καθισαι συν αυτω' (immediately sat down with him) describes the action of sitting down together. The Vietnamese 'ngồi cùng xe với mình' (sat in the same car/vehicle) adds the concept of a 'car' (xe) which is not present in the Greek text.
